solutionContexts.label: Preformed octanethiol-capped Ag nanocrystals in hexane
solutionContexts.scope: Main PDF p.2 reports a preformed, size-selected, nominal 3 nm octanethiol-capped Ag nanocrystal dispersion in hexane at 1–2 mg/mL. The article does not specify whether the concentration mass includes the cap. Octanethiol was already on the nanocrystals; no free-ligand dose is reported. A roughly 3 µL drop describes most experiments, not a confirmed Figure 1 aliquot. The cited upstream Ag-core synthesis is not reconstructed. Component cards are separate references, not a measured solution geometry or ligand-coverage model.
